library_supplier_contracts.inspected_contract: Under AC, every finite-dimensional symmetric PSD covariance defines a possibly singular Gaussian law with specified mean/covariance; the ML-24 density/precision graph adds Σ≻0.
Under AC, conditional independence is equality of conditional expectations for all pairs of bounded measurable functions, a.s.
Expectation is the extended integral for nonnegative measurable variables and a finite integral for integrable variables.
On finite-dimensional real/complex inner-product spaces, nonnegative operators are self-adjoint with nonnegative eigenvalues and admit PSD matrix/S*S characterizations.
Finite-dimensional real self-adjoint endomorphisms have an orthonormal eigenbasis; used only for the finite PSD/spectral clauses.
A C² function on an open convex Euclidean domain is convex iff its Hessian is PSD; only the logdet smooth term uses this criterion.
Defines convexity/strict convexity on Euclidean domains; local trace and entrywise absolute-value arguments establish the needed objective properties.

library_supplier_contracts.inspected_contract: Under AC, CI is equality of bounded conditional-product expectations a.s.; it supplies probability notation, not a DAG implication.
